lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, especially for major changes, redesigns, and new screens.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) yielded mixed results across 3 tests, with only 1 win.
Evidence remains thin for all other change kinds (redesigns, incentives, layouts, home hints) due to single tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Visual Choice Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to use visual choice cards for auth methods instead of standard action buttons.
candidates.why: Sign-in step takes median 3s but mean 567s with a 79.1% conversion rate. Distinct visual cards reduce cognitive friction and clarify account creation choices.

sign_in.headline: Connect Your Pet Account
sign_in.body: Choose your preferred sign-in method to keep your pet safely synced.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Companion Persona Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Insert a short interactive quiz screen right before choose_path to guide users toward preset vs custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path dropoff is 23.9% (76.1% conversion) with a mean time of 514s, showing users get stuck deciding how to create their pet.

new_persona_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion Match
new_persona_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions so we can recommend the best pet creation style for you.

guard.reason: Inserts a new persona quiz screen into onboarding without removing required steps or violating rules.

candidates.score_note: New screens historically hurt conversion and add friction despite moderate step dropoff.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Card Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a compact card layout and rounded companion selection elements.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in early setup at 60.9%, taking median 89s and mean 1017s. A compact card structure makes comparing pet options faster.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet to bring to your desktop desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Updates the pick_friend layout to compact choice cards while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact on adoption dropoff, but redesigns consistently underperform.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Drop Preview Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the home_intro screen with an interactive pet preview component allowing users to drag and test their pet avatar.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, and 3 support emails specifically reported confusion around how to control or view their pet on the desktop.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Try dragging your pet across the screen to get comfortable with desktop interaction.

guard.reason: Rebuilds home_intro with an interactive pet preview inside onboarding as allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and funnel, but complex new flows typically fail to deliver lift.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Mascot Animation and Audio
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot and subtle chime audio cue to the waiting screen during pet creation.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s. Engaging audio-visual feedback prevents users from assuming the app has frozen.

guard.reason: Adds mascot animation and chime audio to the waiting screen while retaining progress indication.

candidates.score_note: Home dropoff is low, but wait_info changes have shown positive results (+1.5%).

candidates.title: Account Cloud Backup Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Reframe the sign_in headline and body copy around protecting pet progress and cloud backup.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) was pets missing or resetting after signing in again. Clear reassurance upfront builds confidence in signing in.

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Companion with Cloud Backup
sign_in.body: Signing in automatically saves your pet memories, progress, and settings so you never lose them.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to emphasize cloud backup while keeping sign-in functionality intact.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence and low cost, but sign-in copy tweaks historically perform poorly.

candidates.title: Choose Path Centered Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to centered framing to focus user attention on the two primary creation paths.
candidates.why: 23.9% of users abandon at choose_path. Centered focus reduces clutter and encourages immediate action.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-go companion preset or create a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Refreshes choose_path layout and copy while clearly offering both adoption and custom creation paths.

candidates.score_note: Layout adjustments on choose_path previously delivered a positive +2.5% lift.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Highlight
candidates.change: Add a visual certified companion badge and mascot animation to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has a heavy dropoff (60.9% conversion). Adding a playful confirmation badge creates an emotional reward moment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop companion is officially registered and ready!

guard.reason: Enhances the adoption certificate with a certified badge stamp and mascot animation.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest dropoff step with emotional incentive elements that tend to perform well.

candidates.title: Background Generation Completion Sound Notification
candidates.change: Enable background audio completion chime when pet generation finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on home/waiting screen is 2336s, indicating users tab away. A completion chime alerts them when their pet is ready.

guard.reason: Adds background notification sound and readiness setting to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost wait_info change addressing long wait times, expected modest gain.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint Banner
candidates.change: Display a hint banner on the home_intro screen explaining how to access right-click companion settings.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and multiple support tickets mention confusion over how to control, hide, or interact with the pet once onboarded.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your desktop companion anytime to open controls, hide, or talk to your pet.

guard.reason: Adds an instructional hint banner to home_intro explaining desktop controls.

candidates.score_note: Backed by strong evidence, but finish step hints historically show zero net effect.

picked: Interactive Desktop Pet Drop Preview Flow

decisions.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Drop Preview Flow

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though some changes like compact layouts outperformed predictions.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) either hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.
